CPU:Check of coin weight.name: Check of weight of coin
CPU:Check of coin weight.description: Checks if a weight of a coin is in accepted interval

CPU:Check of coin form.name: Check of form of coin
CPU:Check of coin form.description: Checks if a form of coin is accepted

CPU:Acceptance of coin.name: Aceceptance of coin
CPU:Acceptance of coin.description: Accept a real coin and save it in internal tresor

CPU>Coin candidate inserted.name: Coin candidate
CPU>Coin candidate inserted.description: Some artifact is putted in coin slot. This signal contains data with this artifact

CPU>Coin is OK.name: Coin is ok
CPU>Coin is OK.description: Coin checker send this signal, when coin is checked and can be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this coin

CPU>Coin rejected.name: Coin is not ok (rejected)
CPU>Coin rejected.description: Coin checker send this signal, when coin is checked and can't be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this coin

CPU>Change is needed.name: Change is needed
CPU>Change is needed.description: Coin Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted coin requires change. Data contains the change value.

CPU>Change is not needed.name: Change is not needed
CPU>Change is not needed.description: Coin Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted coin requires no change.

CPU.Check coin weight.name: Check coin weight
CPU.Check coin weight.description: Command to Coin Checker to validate the weight of the coin candidate. Data contains the coin artifact.

CPU.Check coin form.name: Check coin form
CPU.Check coin form.description: Command to Coin Checker to validate the form/shape of the coin candidate. Data contains the coin artifact.

CPU.accept coin.name: Accept coin
CPU.accept coin.description: Command to Coin Acceptor to accept the validated coin. Data contains the coin artifact.
